name: @bongtu/client
description: bongtu client engine — the React-free, rail-agnostic protocol layer both apps drive: key derivation core + the in-memory KeyCache lock, login/session/key-binding, witness assembly (spend/deposit/consumer), the prove+submit flow orchestrations over the structural rail seam (src/rail.ts), indexer reads and refresh policy, and the kKRW money edge. Rail io (viem submits, the wallet Connection edge, the EIP-712 seed) lives in @bongtu/client-evm; this package's dependency closure carries NO rail SDK (gated by test/railFree.test.ts). App config (pool, token, explorer, prover) is threaded in through each flow's ctx/deps seam — this package reads no env and imports no app config.
